## Summary
All existing callers of completion-verifier (sprint, debug-everything, preplanning) are migrated to read the new schema_version=2 typed-enum P1 field instead of the legacy schema.

## Done Definitions
- All consumer call sites identified (audit of all callers of completion-verifier)
- Each consumer updated to read schema_version=2 typed-enum field
- Backward-compat shim for schema_version=1 responses (if any consumers cannot be updated atomically)
- Integration test: schema_version=2 response correctly parsed by each updated consumer
- No consumer silently reads stale field after migration

## SC Coverage
SC1 (consumer side)

## Depends On
S1 (schema must be defined before consumers can be migrated)

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
